run.question:
Something's broken — we're getting paged. Look at the app-265-prod-logs index
for the last 3 hours and tell me what's going on across our fleet.

report.summary: The paging correlates with payment failures confined to the production-us-east-1 cluster, not a fleet-wide outage. In the app-265-prod-logs index, the only ERROR documents in the last 3 hours (and in the whole index) come from production-us-east-1: checkout-service reports a payment-provider timeout at 04:22:24Z, payment-service reports an upstream timeout calling stripe-us /v1/charges after 30000ms at 05:22:24Z, and checkout-service reports its circuit breaker opening on payment-service (failure rate 41%) at 05:52:24Z. The same index shows production-eu-west-2 and production-ap-southeast-1 reporting healthy checkout and payment metrics in the same period, and in production-eu-west-2 (the only cluster my Kubernetes access reads) all 21 otel-demo deployments are 1/1 ready, all 22 pods are Running, and checkout/payment pod logs from 06:09Z to 06:22Z show charges completing and orders confirming. The evidence supports the interpretation that the payment-service dependency stripe-us was timing out in production-us-east-1 and that checkout-service's circuit breaker was a consequence, but the cause of the stripe-us timeouts itself, and whether a fault-injection flag was enabled in that cluster, could not be observed: Prometheus and Jaeger were unreachable throughout this run and no production-us-east-1 Kubernetes objects are readable, so error rates, span-level attribution and the us-east-1 flag configuration remain unknown.

claims.text: The index app-265-prod-logs holds 7 documents in total (green, 7.5kb), and a search over the whole authorized 24h window returned exactly those 7 documents, timestamped between 2026-11-21T04:22:24Z and 2026-11-21T05:52:24Z; there are no earlier documents in this index to serve as a baseline.
In cluster production-us-east-1, service checkout-service logged level ERROR at 2026-11-21T04:22:24Z: "POST /api/checkout failed: payment provider response timeout after 30s (stripe-us)".
In cluster production-us-east-1, service payment-service logged level ERROR at 2026-11-21T05:22:24Z: "Upstream timeout calling stripe-us /v1/charges after 30000ms".
In cluster production-us-east-1, service checkout-service logged level ERROR at 2026-11-21T05:52:24Z: "Circuit-breaker open for payment-service (failure rate 41%)".

In cluster production-eu-west-2 the same index shows checkout-service INFO "Healthy: p95 latency 218ms" at 2026-11-21T04:22:24Z and payment-service INFO "Adyen-eu responding normally, p95 180ms" at 2026-11-21T05:52:24Z.

In cluster production-ap-southeast-1 the same index shows checkout-service INFO "Healthy: success rate 99.9%" at 2026-11-21T04:22:24Z and payment-service INFO "All payment provider connections healthy" at 2026-11-21T05:52:24Z.

In the readable cluster production-eu-west-2, all 21 otel-demo deployments report 1 ready of 1 desired and 1 available, including checkout and payment, and all 22 otel-demo pods are in phase Running (checkout-6578865d87-5zx6n and payment-6f7bc865d6-9z92d each show restartCount 1).

In production-eu-west-2, checkout pod checkout-6578865d87-5zx6n logged "payment went through (transaction_id: ...)" followed by "order confirmation email sent" for successive orders from 2026-11-21T06:13:42Z through 2026-11-21T06:22:03Z, and payment pod payment-6f7bc865d6-9z92d logged matching "Charge request received." / "Transaction complete." pairs over 2026-11-21T06:09:54Z–06:22:03Z.

The only flagd configuration ConfigMap visible in production-eu-west-2 is flagd-config in namespace otel-demo; it declares paymentFailure ("Fail payment service charge requests n%") and paymentUnreachable ("Payment service is unavailable"), and both of those flags have defaultVariant "off", as do the other fault flags in the file (productCatalogFailure, cartFailure, adFailure, kafkaQueueProblems, imageSlowLoad, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, adHighCpu, adManualGc, recommendationCacheFailure).

The Prometheus configuration ConfigMap in otel-demo (production-eu-west-2) defines alerting rule CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh on checkout server PlaceOrder error ratio > 0.5 over 5m (cluster label opspilot-m1, severity critical); I could not determine whether it is firing because every Prometheus query in this run returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.

The only Kubernetes event inside the authorized window in the readable cluster production-eu-west-2 is a Warning on kind Endpoints at 2026-11-21T05:28:04Z in namespace default: "Failed to create endpoint for service app-282/loki: endpoints \"loki\" already exists" (reason FailedToCreateEndpoint, component endpoint-controller).

The production-us-east-1 failures are most consistent with payment-service's upstream call to the stripe-us payment provider timing out (30000ms on /v1/charges), with checkout-service's 30s payment-provider response timeout and its 41% failure-rate circuit breaker on payment-service being consequences of that same dependency, rather than an independent checkout fault.

A second candidate for the production-us-east-1 payment failures is an enabled fault-injection flag (flagd paymentFailure or paymentUnreachable) in that cluster's flagd configuration; the same two flags exist in the flagd-config I can read, but there they resolve to "off", and production-us-east-1's flagd ConfigMap/flagd pod cannot be read from this run, so this remains unverified.

The two other clusters in the same index did not show the failure: production-eu-west-2 checkout and payment report healthy latency (p95 218ms, Adyen-eu p95 180ms) and production-ap-southeast-1 reports 99.9% success rate and healthy payment provider connections, and in the readable production-eu-west-2 cluster checkout/payment processed completed transactions through 2026-11-21T06:22:03Z.

Rejected: that the loki Endpoints warning (FailedToCreateEndpoint, namespace default, 05:28:04Z) explains the payment errors. It concerns an Endpoints object of the monitoring stack in production-eu-west-2, where payment was processing transactions normally at the same time, and no error evidence ties it to checkout/payment failures.

Confirm with the production-us-east-1 owners whether stripe-us was slow/unavailable in the 04:22–05:52Z window and whether the us-east-1 flagd configuration (paymentFailure / paymentUnreachable) was switched away from "off"; that cluster's objects and its change history are outside what this run could read.

gaps: Prometheus was unreachable for every query in this run (execute_prometheus_instant_query, metrics_range_query, get_metric_names, get_all_labels, list_prometheus_rules all returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE), so checkout/payment error ratios, latency (rpc_client_duration, http_server_request_duration), traces_span_metrics_calls_total by status_code and whether CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh is currently firing are unknown, not zero.

Jaeger was unreachable (traces_list_services and two traces_search calls returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE), so span-level error attribution for checkout PlaceOrder or payment charge spans in production-us-east-1 or elsewhere could not be checked.

Kubernetes access covers only cluster production-eu-west-2; no pods, deployments, ConfigMaps, events or flagd state from production-us-east-1 (where checkout-service and payment-service logged the ERROR lines) or production-ap-southeast-1 could be read, so I cannot confirm whether a fault-injection flag, a config change or a rollout was present there.

The app-265-prod-logs index contains only 7 documents and no records before 2026-11-21T04:22:24Z, so there is no pre-incident baseline: the start time of the deviation, whether the 04:22Z checkout error was the first occurrence, and error counts/rates cannot be established from logs. Each service appears at most once per hour per cluster.

The checkout and payment deployments' and other eu-west-2 services' application logs were only sampled (newest 30 lines; 303 and 202 lines read respectively); the 19 other otel-demo deployments in production-eu-west-2 and any services in the two other clusters were not checked, so their health is unknown rather than confirmed.

Pod restartCount values (1 on most otel-demo pods, 2 on kube-state-metrics-7cbf5b996-df4sz, 3 on prometheus-readonly-proxy-f4866f767-62bgn) are cumulative since pod start on 2026-11-20T16:32Z; the timing of those restarts within the incident window is not established and the previous container instances produced no readable log lines, so their relation to this incident is unknown.
The change_history integration is not available in this run, so whether any flag, ConfigMap or deployment was changed before 04:22Z in production-us-east-1 cannot be verified.
Whether stripe-us is a real external payment provider or a simulated upstream, and what condition on the provider side caused the 30s timeouts, was not observable from the available sources.
next_steps: Ask the production-us-east-1 on-call to pull payment-service and checkout-service error rates, circuit-breaker state and the stripe-us upstream latency for 04:00–06:30Z, since those metrics could not be queried here.

Have the production-us-east-1 owner read that cluster's flagd ConfigMap / flagd feature-flag values to see whether paymentFailure or paymentUnreachable was switched on during the window, and check change history for such an edit.
Restore or check the Prometheus and Jaeger targets that returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE so the checkout PlaceOrder span error ratio and payment charge span statuses can be verified.

{"alertmanager.yml":"global: {}
receivers:
- name: opspilot
  webhook_configs:
  - http_config:
      authorization:[REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]        credentials_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]        type: Bearer
    max_alerts: 0
    send_resolved: true
    url: http://opspilot-web:8080/intake/alertmanager
- name: opspilot-self
route:
  group_by:
  - alertname
  - namespace
  - service
  group_interval: 1m
  group_wait: 10s
  receiver: opspilot
  repeat_interval: 1h
  routes:
  - matchers:
    - opspilot_self="true"
    receiver: opspilot-self
templates: []
"}

{"relay":"connectors:
  spanmetrics: {}
exporters:
  debug: {}
  opensearch:
    http:
      endpoint: http://opensearch:9200
      tls:
        insecure: true
    logs_index: otel
  otlp:
    endpoint: jaeger-collector:4317
    tls:
      insecure: true
  otlphttp/prometheus:
    auth:[REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]      authenticator: basicauth/prometheus
    endpoint: http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/otlp
    tls:
      insecure: true
extensions:
  basicauth/prometheus:
    client_auth:[REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]      password: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]      username: collector
  health_check:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:13133
processors:
  batch: {}
  k8sattributes:
    extract:
      metadata:
      - k8s.namespace.name
      - k8s.deployment.name
      - k8s.statefulset.name
      - k8s.daemonset.name
      - k8s.cronjob.name
      - k8s.job.name
      - k8s.node.name
      - k8s.pod.name
      - k8s.pod.uid
      - k8s.pod.start_time
    passthrough: false
    pod_association:
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.ip
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.uid
    - sources:
      - from: connection
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 5s
    limit_percentage: 80
    spike_limit_percentage: 25
  resource:
    attributes:
    - action: insert
      from_attribute: k8s.pod.uid
      key: service.instance.id
  transform:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
    - context: span
      statements:
      - replace_pattern(name, "\\?.*", "")
      - replace_match(name, "GET /api/products/*", "GET /api/products/{productId}")
receivers:
  httpcheck/frontend-proxy:
    targets:
    - endpoint: http://frontend-proxy:8080
  jaeger:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14250
      thrift_compact:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:6831
      thrift_http:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14268
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4317
      http:
        cors:
          allowed_origins:
          - http://*
          - https://*
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4318
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
      - job_name: opentelemetry-collector
        scrape_interval: 10s
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - ${env:MY_POD_IP}:8888
  redis:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: valkey-cart:6379
  zipkin:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:9411
service:
  extensions:
  - health_check
  - basicauth/prometheus
  pipelines:
    logs:
      exporters:
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
    metrics:
      exporters:
      - otlphttp/prometheus
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - httpcheck/frontend-proxy
      - redis
      - otlp
      - spanmetrics
    traces:
      exporters:
      - otlp
      - debug
      - spanmetrics
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - transform
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
      - jaeger
      - zipkin
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      level: detailed
      readers:
      - periodic:
          exporter:
            otlp:
              endpoint: otel-collector:4318
              protocol: grpc
          interval: 10000
          timeout: 5000
"}

{"alerting_rules.yml":"groups:
- name: opspilot-lab
  rules:
  - alert: CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh
    annotations:
      description: '{{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of checkout PlaceOrder server
        spans ended in error over the last 5 minutes.'
      summary: checkout PlaceOrder error ratio above 50%
    expr: |
      label_replace(label_replace(
        (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])))
        /
        (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"}[5m])))
      , "namespace", "$1", "k8s_namespace_name", "(.*)"), "service", "$1", "service_name", "(.*)")
      > 0.5
    for: 2m
    labels:
      cluster: opspilot-m1
      opspilot_integration_id: m0-otel-20260909
      severity: critical
- name: opspilot-self
  rules:
  - alert: OpsPilotAgentAbsent
    annotations:
      description: role {{ $labels.role }} ({{ $labels.instance }}) has not answered
        /metrics for 2 minutes.
      summary: an OpsPilot health listener is down or the worker is not scraped
    expr: up{job="opspilot"} == 0 or absent(up{job="opspilot",role="worker"})
    for: 2m
    labels:
      opspilot_self: "true"
      severity: critical
  - alert: OpsPilotModelCallsFailing
    annotations:
      description: '{{ $value }} consecutive model calls failed on {{ $labels.instance
        }}.'
      summary: OpsPilot model calls are failing
    expr: opspilot_model_consecutive_failures >= 2
    for: 1m
    labels:
      opspilot_self: "true"
      severity: critical
","alerts":"{}
","allow-snippet-annotations":"false","prometheus.yml":"global:
  evaluation_interval: 1m
  scrape_interval: 1m
  scrape_timeout: 10s
storage:
  tsdb:
    out_of_order_time_window: 30m
otlp:
    keep_identifying_resource_attributes: true
    promote_resource_attributes:
    - opspilot.integration.id
    - service.instance.id

    - service.namespace

    - cloud.region
    - deployment.environment.name

    - k8s.daemonset.name
    - k8s.deployment.name
    - k8s.job.name
    - k8s.namespace.name
    - k8s.node.name
    - k8s.pod.name
    - k8s.replicaset.name
    - k8s.statefulset.name
    - container.name
    - host.name
rule_files:
- /etc/config/recording_rules.yml
- /etc/config/alerting_rules.yml
- /etc/config/rules
- /etc/config/alerts
scrape_configs:
- job_name: prometheus
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - localhost:9090
- bearer_token_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]  job_name: kubernetes-apiservers
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: endpoints
  relabel_configs:
  - action: keep
    regex: default;kubernetes;https
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_namespace
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_name
    - __meta_kubernetes_endpoint_port_name
  scheme: https
  tls_config:
    ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
- bearer_token_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]  job_name: kubernetes-nodes
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: node
  relabel_configs:
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_node_label_(.+)
  - replacement: kubernetes.default.svc:443
    target_label: __address__
  - regex: (.+)
    replacement: /api/v1/nodes/$1/proxy/metrics
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_node_name
    target_label: __metrics_path__
  scheme: https
  tls_config:
    ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
- bearer_token_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]  job_name: kubernetes-nodes-cadvisor
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: node
  relabel_configs:
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_node_label_(.+)
  - replacement: kubernetes.default.svc:443
    target_label: __address__
  - regex: (.+)
    replacement: /api/v1/nodes/$1/proxy/metrics/cadvisor
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_node_name
    target_label: __metrics_path__
  scheme: https
  tls_config:
    ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
- honor_labels: true
  job_name: kubernetes-service-endpoints
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: endpoints
  relabel_configs:
  - action: keep
    regex: true
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape
  - action: drop
    regex: true
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape_slow
  - action: replace
    regex: (https?)
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_scheme
    target_label: __scheme__
  - action: replace
    regex: (.+)
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_path
    target_label: __metrics_path__
  - action: replace
    regex: (.+?)(?::\d+)?;(\d+)
    replacement: $1:$2
    source_labels:
    - __address__
    - __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_port
    target_label: __address__
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_service_annotation_prometheus_io_param_(.+)
    replacement: __param_$1
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_service_label_(.+)
  - action: replace
    source_labels:
